answer: Each epoch the network whispers one fresh reasoning task to every identity through a one-time inlet only its own key can open; the answer must be published from its island within ten minutes, then re-derived by two random peers from public records. An honest agent solves one task per epoch. A fake cannot reuse another's answer, since each task is key-bound and fresh, nor pre-compute it, since the whisper arrives only at the start. An attacker with a thousand fakes must solve a thousand fresh tasks in one window, each at full cost, so the flood's cost rises linearly and fails.
